differences.openwhisper: Offers multiple local speech backends. Its model catalog includes Nemotron alongside Parakeet and Orukeet.
differences.fiorivoce: Uses NeMo-Speech.cpp for its one local Parakeet engine. The catalog lists Parakeet TDT and its Orukeet adaptation.
differences.reason: The project selected this engine family for the C++ rewrite. Runtime selection permits separate CPU and GPU builds.

differences.openwhisper: The optional backend implements automatic CPU fallback for selected engines, including Qwen and transcribe.cpp.
differences.fiorivoce: A Parakeet model on Auto retries on the CPU when GPU initialization fails and reports the reason. An explicitly requested GPU reports its load error.
differences.reason: The same device-selection rule applies to the engine shipped with FioriVoce.

differences.openwhisper: The NVIDIA Speech rows say the runtime is shared by Parakeet and Nemotron, 'Runs in a dedicated process', local format 'Isolated worker process', payload 'portable Python on Windows', add the Python PSF licence and link the Python 3.12.10 download page.
differences.fiorivoce: The rows say 'Parakeet models', 'Runs inside FioriVoce', local format 'Native libraries loaded by FioriVoce', payload 'Verified native libraries', and drop the Python licence and link; every other field is OpenWhisper's, with the product named by identity().
differences.reason: FioriVoce loads the runtime into its own process without an embedded Python and ships only the Parakeet family, so the upstream wording would describe software it does not install.
differences.source: docs/port/packages/M2.md M2.5 'Traps' (map a14 A14-21, A14-68); src/models/component_details.h and tests/models/test_component_details.cpp fiorivoce_row

differences.openwhisper: A component is installed, updated or removed at once; no component row waits for a restart.
differences.fiorivoce: An update or removal of the speech runtime that is loaded is staged and applied at the next start: its Downloads row shows 'Restart needed' and offers nothing more, and describe() gives 'Restart FioriVoce to finish installing the component.' or 'Restart FioriVoce to finish removing the component.'
differences.reason: The NeMo-Speech.cpp runtime runs inside FioriVoce's process and cannot be unloaded (FreeLibrary crashes the process), so a change to the loaded runtime waits for the next start.
differences.source: The models sweep of 2026-11-19 (open item describe() and is_installed()); src/models/coordinator.cpp describe, src/models/downloads_model.cpp; tests/models/test_component_lifecycle.cpp ('describe() names a change staged for the next start, and the row offers nothing more', 'removing the loaded runtime is staged and done at the next start')

differences.openwhisper: OpenWhisper has no setting for a runtime folder of the user's choosing; its runtimes come from its components only.
differences.fiorivoce: A runtime folder chosen in fv_runtime_dir is checked for the runtime library and its build. Without the library the engine is a missing runtime with 'No speech runtime in <dir>: <library> was not found.'; a CPU build keeps device Auto on the CPU and refuses an explicit GPU with '<dir> holds a CPU build of NeMo-Speech.cpp, so Parakeet can't use the GPU with it.'
differences.reason: A folder the user picks may hold no runtime or a CPU-only build; saying which before the load fails tells the user what to change.
differences.source: The models sweep of 2026-11-19 (open item models/engine_resolution.cpp); src/models/engine_resolution.cpp, src/engine/runtime.cpp find_runtime_library; tests/models/test_sweep_runtime_dir.cpp ('runtime_dir_serves needs the library, and a GPU build for a GPU runtime', 'a chosen folder without the runtime library is a missing runtime', 'a chosen CPU build keeps Auto on the CPU and refuses an explicit GPU')
